Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1065
Claimant:
Christy Fowler
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2024-06-06
The claimant reported a sideswipe during a lane change and said they are handling the claim without a lawyer. The
insured driver is listed on the policy, and the adjuster confirmed the vehicle is covered for this period.
2024-07-13
Police attended the scene and confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle. Statements from two independent
witnesses match the claimant's description of how the collision happened.
2024-07-30
Photos of both vehicles were obtained. The damage to the claimant's car lines up with the impact described by the
other driver and the witnesses.
2024-08-12
The claimant reported a concussion and said symptoms began shortly after the crash. The reported injury is
consistent with a side impact of this kind, and no earlier injury to the head or neck is known.
2024-09-01
Records show the vehicle had no prior damage in the same area, and nothing suggests the damage predates the
start of coverage.
2024-09-02
In a second conversation, the claimant described the direction of the impact differently from the first call. The claimant
also gave a different number of occupants in the car than before.
2024-10-06
The adjuster asked the claimant to clarify the changes. The claimant said the first account was given while still
shaken, but the police report and witness statements continue to support the original sequence of events.
2024-11-12
Medical records show treatment followed a typical course for this kind of injury. Symptoms eased steadily and the
treatment visits tapered off as the claimant improved.
2024-11-22
The file is being reviewed with the discrepancies in the claimant's statements noted. Coverage remains in place, and
the adjuster will request updated medical information before the injury evaluation is finalized.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
